instruction: I need to convert a video file to audio format. The video is on my Desktop and it's called "Baby Justin Bieber.mp4". Please use VLC to extract the audio and save it on the Desktop. The output file must be named exactly "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" - make sure the extension is .mp3, not .mp4 or anything else.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires extracting audio from MP4 using VLC with emphasis on actual file format conversion verification. The evaluator performs multi-step validation: (1) file exists at specified path (20%), (2) file is actually audio format verified by MIME type check using 'file' command (40%), (3) basename exactly matches 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp3' (30%), and (4) extension is 'mp3' not 'mp4' or other (10%). The getter uses 'file' command to verify actual file type preventing simple rename attacks, 'basename' command to extract the filename, and parses the extension. This ensures the agent actually performed video-to-audio conversion, not just renamed the file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies actual file format conversion using MIME type check (vlc.py:52-67)
Getter uses 'file -b --mime-type' command to check actual file type, not just filename
Metric awards 40% score (largest portion) only if is_audio flag is true (requires audio/* MIME type)
File renaming attack is prevented: Renaming .mp4 to .mp3 would fail MIME type check and score only 60%
All instruction requirements verified: file exists (20%), actual audio format (40%), correct basename (30%), correct extension (10%)
Complete coverage: Checks both surface requirements (filename/extension) and core requirement (actual audio conversion)
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime: Uses standard Linux 'file' command for MIME type detection
